0.title: What is a WhatsApp campaign?
0.body: A campaign queue that sends a custom message, approved template, or flow to selected contacts through your connected device.

1.title: How do I improve delivery?
1.body: Keep lists clean, use approved templates for outbound sends, and schedule larger campaigns instead of pushing every contact at once.

2.title: Which campaign should I launch first?
2.body: Begin with a template update or re-engagement campaign, then compare delivered, read, and failed counts before scaling.
